newsitem.title: USA: MBIA has capacity for two California issuers.
newsitem.headline: MBIA has capacity for two California issuers.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Friday it approved for secondary market insurance two California debt issues.

The firm said it has a limited amount of capacity for San Bernardino County, Calif., certificates of participation series 1994, Medical Center project, and capacity in various California State Public Works Board bonds.
Capacity is limited and is available on a first-come, first-served basis. For more information, call 800-624-2669.
